svg.title: Six defect families and what the proposed model changes for each
svg.desc: Bar chart with notes. The six defect families in the Launchpad record, by count, with the change the Proof of Work model proposes for each: Wrong assumption in plan, 55: Still introduced; a journey claim against a real stack catches it before merge. Of the 55, 31 were found live and 8 in production. Instrument confirms expectation, 47 (invisible to the gate by construction): An observation that will be made twice becomes a script in scripts/ with a known-positive test. Of the 47, 36 were caught only after a wrong conclusion. Second caller never wired, 35 (invisible to the gate by construction): Required parameters and a lint rule catch it at compile time; the 17 optional-parameter cases fail to compile. Environment or deploy drift, 19: Live claims run under the deploying identity and check the end state on the server. Assert-the-call test, 9: Each claim names an observable effect, and breakcheck rejects a check that stays green when that effect is removed. Record says done before the world is, 8: Only the check that observed the state may write the status. The six family counts sum to 173 of the 225 defects. Source: docs/PROOF-OF-WORK.md, sections 1, 3.3 and 4.
